Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant pyuria, bacteriuria, nitrites, and positive urine culture for >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, consistent with a urinary tract infection. Hematuria and proteinuria are present. Low specific gravity may indicate dilute urine. No casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and consideration of antibiotic therapy.
